license_required.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

type.quote: The Oklahoma Board of Nursing is hereby established in the State of Oklahoma.

age_minimum.quote: Is a minimum of eighteen (18) years of age

degree_required.value: Accredited college or university program leading to an associate, baccalaureate, or higher degree in nursing (RN); state-approved practical nursing program (LPN); accredited graduate-level program in one of four APRN roles (APRN)
degree_required.quote: the program shall be conducted in the State of Oklahoma in an accredited college or university leading to an associate, baccalaureate, or higher degree in nursing

accrediting_body.value: National League for Nursing Accrediting Commission, Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education, American College of Nurse-Midwives Division on Accreditation, or American Association of Nurse Anesthetists' Council on Accreditation of Nurse Anesthesia Educational Programs (for APRN)
accrediting_body.quote: The program holds accreditation or holds candidacy, pre-accreditation, or applicant status for accreditation from the National League for Nursing Accrediting Commission, the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education, the American College of Nurse-Midwives Division on Accreditation, or the American Association of Nurse Anesthetists' Council on Accreditation of Nurse Anesthesia Educational Programs

degree_level.quote: an accredited college or university leading to an associate, baccalaureate, or higher degree in nursing

school_approval_basis.quote: Such programs shall meet the standards fixed by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing and prescribed in its rules.

credential_pegged.quote: Has completed the basic professional curricula of a school of nursing approved by a state board of nursing, and holds or is entitled to hold a diploma or degree therefrom

tiers.quote: an accredited college or university leading to an associate, baccalaureate, or higher degree in nursing
Effective January 1, 2016, the applicant shall have completed an accredited graduate level advanced practice registered nursing education program

required.quote: Has completed the basic professional curricula of a school of nursing approved by a state board of nursing, and holds or is entitled to hold a diploma or degree therefrom

experience_source.quote: Has completed the basic professional curricula of a school of nursing approved by a state board of nursing, and holds or is entitled to hold a diploma or degree therefrom

exams.name: NCLEX-RN
exams.notes: Written examination required for RN licensure; passing criteria set by Board rules
exams.quote: An applicant for a license shall be required to pass a written examination in such subjects as the Board may determine.

exams.name: NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: Written examination required for LPN licensure; passing criteria set by Board rules
exams.quote: The applicant for a license to practice as a Licensed Practical Nurse shall be required to pass a written examination in such subjects as the Board may require.

exams.name: National APRN certification examination
exams.notes: APRN applicant must be currently certified by a national certifying body recognized by the Board
exams.quote: Be currently certified in an advanced practice specialty certification consistent with educational preparation and by a national certifying body recognized by the Board

interval_years.quote: a license or certificate shall be renewed every two (2) years according to a schedule published by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing

renewal_fee_usd.quote: no single fee for an initial application for licensure or certification, or for renewal, reinstatement or return to active practice shall exceed One Hundred Twenty-five Dollars ($125.00)

required.quote: provide evidence of completion, within the two-year period immediately preceding the date of application, of a minimum of fifteen (15) units of continuing education in advanced pharmacology related to the administration of anesthesia as recognized by the National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists

hours_per_period.quote: a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist shall submit documentation of a minimum of eight (8) units of continuing education, completed during the previous two (2) years, in advanced pharmacology relating to the administration of anesthesia

period_years.quote: The Board shall provide by rule for biennial application renewal and reauthorization of authority to order, select, obtain, and administer drugs for Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists.

value: advanced pharmacology relating to the administration of anesthesia (CRNA)
pharmacotherapeutics, clinical application, and use of pharmacological agents (CNP/CNS/CNM renewal)
pain management or opioid use or addiction (CNP/CNS/CNM renewal)
topical_requirements.quote: fifteen (15) contact hours or one (1) academic credit hour of education in pharmacotherapeutics, clinical application, and use of pharmacological agents in the prevention of illness, and in the restoration and maintenance of health

available.quote: The Board may issue a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse without examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed as a Registered Nurse under the laws of another state, territory, the District of Columbia or a foreign country, if such applicant meets the qualifications required for licensing as a Registered Nurse in this state.

requirements.value: Applicant must meet Oklahoma's qualifications for RN licensure. For APRN, applicant must hold current RN and APRN licenses in the state, hold recognition as an APRN in the same role and specialty in another state or territory, complete education and pharmacotherapeutics documentation, and submit supervision agreements or proof of independent prescriptive authority eligibility.
requirements.quote: The Board may issue a license by endorsement to an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse licensed under the laws of another state if the applicant meets the qualifications for licensure in this state.

exists.quote: The Oklahoma Board of Nursing is hereby established in the State of Oklahoma.

national_certification.value: National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists
national_certification.quote: certified by the National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists as a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist within one (1) year following completion of an approved Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist education program

national_association.quote: possesses evidence of certification according to the requirements of the American College of Nurse-Midwives

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

credential_type.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

title_protection.quote: Any person who holds a license to practice as a registered nurse in this state shall have the right to use both the title "Registered Nurse" and the abbreviation "R.N." No other person shall assume such title or use such abbreviation, or any other words, letters, signs or figures to indicate that the person using the same is a registered nurse.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Deceit or material misrepresentation in procuring or attempting to procure a nursing license or AUA certification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of deceit or material misrepresentation in procuring or attempting to procure: a. a license to practice registered nursing, licensed practical nursing, or a license to practice advanced practice registered nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any offense substantially related to nursing qualifications, or involving fraud, dishonesty, or violence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of a felony, or any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any licensee or Advanced Unlicensed Assistant, or any offense an essential element of which is fraud, dishonesty, or an act of violence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately care for patients or conform to minimum standards of acceptable nursing practice, unnecessarily exposing patients to risk of harm
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to adequately care for patients or to conform to the minimum standards of acceptable nursing or Advanced Unlicensed Assistant practice that, in the opinion of the Board, unnecessarily exposes a patient or other person to risk of harm

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intemperance in the use of alcohol or drugs that endangers or could endanger patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is intemperate in the use of alcohol or drugs, which use the Board determines endangers or could endanger patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of practice showing actual or potential inability to practice with sufficient knowledge or safe skills due to impairment from illness, substance use, mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exhibits through a pattern of practice or other behavior actual or potential inability to practice nursing with sufficient knowledge or reasonable skills and safety due to impairment caused by illness, use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals or any other substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudicated as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent, or dangerous to the public, or committed by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been adjudicated as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent or dangerous to the public or has been committed by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined in Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined in the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act that jeopardizes a patient's life, health or safety as defined in Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of any act that jeopardizes a patient's life, health or safety as defined in the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a Board rule or order, or state/federal law relating to nursing or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a rule promulgated by the Board, an order of the Board, or a state or federal law relating to the practice of registered, practical or advanced practice registered nursing or advanced unlicensed assisting, or a state or federal narcotics or controlled dangerous substance law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary actions taken against the individual's nursing license or any professional/occupational license in any state, territory or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had disciplinary actions taken against the individual's registered or practical nursing license, advanced unlicensed assistive certification, or any professional or occupational license, registration or certification in this or any state, territory or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Default or termination from the peer assistance program for any reason
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has defaulted or been terminated from the peer assistance program for any reason

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain professional boundaries with patients as defined in Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to maintain professional boundaries with patients, as defined in the Board rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual misconduct with a current or former patient or key party, inside or outside the health care setting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in sexual misconduct, as defined in Board rules, with a current or former patient or key party, inside or outside the health care setting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly providing gender transition procedures to a child
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly provided gender transition procedures as defined in Section 1 of this act to a child.

insurance_required.quote: An Advanced Practice Registered Nurse, or the employer of the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse on his or her behalf, shall carry malpractice insurance or demonstrate proof of financial responsibility in a minimum amount of One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per occurrence and Three Million Dollars ($3,000,000.00) in the aggregate per year.

definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing means the performance of services provided for purposes of nursing diagnosis and treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems consistent with educational preparation. Knowledge and skill are the basis for assessment, analysis, planning, intervention, and evaluation used in the promotion and maintenance of health and nursing management of illness, injury, infirmity, restoration of optimal function, or death with dignity.
definition_quote.quote: "The practice of nursing" means the performance of services provided for purposes of nursing diagnosis and treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems consistent with educational preparation.

value: assessment of health status of individuals, families, and groups
teaching principles and practice of nursing
performing additional nursing functions beyond basic preparation
execution of medical regime including administration of medications and treatments prescribed by authorized persons
methods_authorized.quote: This practice includes execution of the medical regime including the administration of medications and treatments prescribed by any person authorized by state law to so prescribe

drug_authority.value: APRNs (CNP, CNS, CNM) may obtain prescriptive authority recognition from the Board to prescribe; cannot dispense drugs but may receive, sign for, or dispense professional samples. CRNAs may order, select, obtain, and administer legend drugs and Schedules II-V controlled substances only during perioperative or periobstetrical period, in collaboration with a physician, osteopathic physician, podiatric physician, or dentist with timely on-site consultation available. Independent prescriptive authority available for CNP/CNS/CNM after 6,240 supervised clinical hours.
drug_authority.quote: A Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist, in collaboration with a medical doctor, osteopathic physician, podiatric physician, or dentist licensed in this state, and under conditions in which timely, on-site consultation by such medical doctor, osteopathic physician, podiatric physician, or dentist is available, shall be authorized, pursuant to rules adopted by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing, to order, select, obtain, and administer legend drugs, Schedules II through V controlled substances, devices, and medical gases only when engaged in the preanesthetic preparation and evaluation; anesthesia induction, maintenance, and emergence; and postanesthesia care.

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) — Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) — Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) — Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) — Certified Nurse Practitioner (CNP)
license_tiers.quote: who has obtained a license as an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse in one of the following roles: Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist, Certified Nurse-Midwife, Clinical Nurse Specialist, or Certified Nurse Practitioner.

aprn_role_categories.quote: who has obtained a license as an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse in one of the following roles: Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist, Certified Nurse-Midwife, Clinical Nurse Specialist, or Certified Nurse Practitioner.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Licensed practical nursing" means the practice of nursing under the supervision or direction of a Registered Nurse, licensed physician, or dentist.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: The supervision agreement shall be part of the initial application and the renewal application submitted to the Board for recognition for prescriptive authority for the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An Advanced Practice Registered Nurse recognized by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing as a Certified Nurse Practitioner, Clinical Nurse Specialist, or Certified Nurse-Midwife who has completed a minimum of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) clinical practice hours with prescriptive authority supervised by a physician may apply to the Oklahoma Board of Nursing for authority to prescribe and order independent of supervision.

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: Has completed a minimum of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) clinical practice hours with prescriptive authority supervised by a physician.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: A Certified Nurse Practitioner shall be eligible, in accordance with the scope of practice of the Certified Nurse Practitioner, to obtain recognition as authorized by the Board to prescribe

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: to order, select, obtain, and administer legend drugs, Schedules II through V controlled substances, devices, and medical gases only when engaged in the preanesthetic preparation and evaluation; anesthesia induction, maintenance, and emergence; and postanesthesia care.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Maximum limits established in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes; renewal of prescriptive authority requires 2 hours CE in pain management or opioid use/addiction (unless APRN has no active DEA registration).
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: including, but not limited to prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: delegating those nursing tasks as defined in the rules of the Board that may be performed by an Advanced Unlicensed Assistant

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home-state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.
multistate_license_option_available.citation: Laws 2016, c. 190, § 5 (Nurse Licensure Compact — Article II definitions)

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: There is hereby established a peer assistance program to rehabilitate nurses whose competency may be compromised because of the abuse of drugs or alcohol, so that such nurses can be treated and can return to or continue the practice of nursing in a manner which will benefit the public.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: Has completed a minimum of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) clinical practice hours with prescriptive authority supervised by a physician.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: administers anesthesia in collaboration with a medical doctor, an osteopathic physician, a podiatric physician, or a dentist licensed in this state and under conditions in which timely on-site consultation by such doctor, osteopath, podiatric physician, or dentist is available.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: Establish a Formulary Advisory Council that shall develop and submit to the Board recommendations for an exclusionary formulary that shall list drugs or categories of drugs that shall not be prescribed by an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse recognized to prescribe by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing.

military_education_credit_required.quote: the Oklahoma Board of Nursing shall develop program guidelines for Board-approved nursing education programs to utilize in transitioning veterans with prior military medical training and experience into nursing education programs.
